decision: Bind every campaign attestation evidence record to a requestId observed in the same campaign.

reviews.correctness: Preferred explicit request correlation; service/SHA/key binding alone proves origin but not which campaign request produced the response.
reviews.security: Rejected worker-declared service evidence and uncorrelated signed responses because replaying a valid signed response into another request's evidence would remain ambiguous.
reviews.performance: Preferred offline correlation over durable attestation state or an external attestation service; no extra qrexec round trips and only set-membership validation.

alternatives.approach: Trust requestId only during transport verification
alternatives.rejected: The fact is lost when raw evidence is collected, so qualification cannot independently audit correlation.

alternatives.approach: Persist attestation records in coordinator storage
alternatives.rejected: Adds I/O, schema, lifecycle, and regression surface without improving the current single-run evidence requirement.
Potentially stronger future trust anchor, but adds deployment/key lifecycle and IPC before real Qubes execution is available.

winner.approach: requestId in attestation_verified plus same-campaign observed-request validation
winner.correctness: Strongest available offline correlation between signed response and exercised request.
winner.robustness: Fail-closed on missing requestId or an attested request not observed in that campaign.
winner.latency: No additional qrexec calls; local O(n) collection and membership checks.
winner.regressionRisk: Qualification/evidence only; no MissionQueue or coordinator mutation semantics changed.

failureLessons: Cryptographic verification at transport time is necessary but insufficient if qualification evidence drops the request correlation afterward.
Evidence schemas must evolve with security primitives; tests should fail closed when a newly required binding is absent.
safety: Synthetic/defensive qualification only; no real financial transactions or payment data.
